pages.text: Apotheosis reaches into everything.$(br2)$(li)Gear drops with a rarity and $(l)affixes$().$(li)$(l)Gems$() go into sockets. Cut them at a $(l:gear/apotheosis#gem_cutting_table)Gem Cutting Table$(/l).

$(li)Salvage what you don't want and rework what you keep at the $(l:gear/apotheosis#augmenting_table)Augmenting Table$(/l).$(li)Bookshelves shape your enchantments in ways vanilla never did.$(br2)And some bosses walk the world wearing very good gear.
